author: illustratorsfair
title: Illustrators Fair Needs Spooky Illustrator for Event
content: Spooky friendly illustrator required! We’re in need to fill our next illustrator in residence vacancy. Are you up for an evening of on the spot illustrating? On 29 October @illustratorsfair is teaming up with @thecartoonmuseum to host an evening of SPOOKY creative fun. We need someone to join the team for the evening to: 1. Illustrate some spooky tales as our guests confess their real life ghost experiences. 2. Capture the mood of the night with some moody and expressive images. 3. Surprise us with your personal approach and unique vision. You will retain ownership of all your images but give us permission to post the outcomes across our feeds. You will receive a bursary of £180 for four hours of onsite work and two further hours to refine and format your artwork. You will be featured in a blog interview in our new and evolving Substack channel. You will be fully credited when your images are posted across our feeds. Apply ASAP! The 29th is very soon!!!! Apply by emailing us (contact in bio) including a short description of what you do and why you’re spooky. We also definitely need to see examples of your work. Deadline for applications midnight Sunday 25 October. Contact: atillustratorsfair@gmail.com
